results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: Coverage of Fabio Giglietto's research on how Meta's algorithms reduced visibility for elected Italian parliamentarians while inadvertently amplifying extremist and anti-European content on social media, triggering discussions in the European Parliament.

results.title: Secondo uno studio dell'università di Urbino l'algoritmo di Facebook ora punisce la politica ufficiale e premia gli estremisti antieuropei
results.snippet: News article reporting on the study led by Fabio Giglietto analyzing over 2.5 million Facebook posts, revealing how Meta's political content reduction policies disproportionately penalized official political accounts while increasing reach for extremist networks.

results.title: Facebook, troppa visibilità a estremisti e complottisti: ecco come impatta Meta sulle elezioni
results.snippet: Media report citing Fabio Giglietto's investigation into algorithm changes on Meta platforms and their impact on elections and public discourse in Europe.
